Normalization: Source sequence numbers index the retained ownership_evidence.json.gz calls (one-based). SDK request URLs and headers were not captured. GetObject ChecksumMode=ENABLED is an SDK-derived prerequisite only for calls with measured native checksum response headers and outputs. It reconstructs botocore 1.43.98 _handle_request_validation_mode_member with response_checksum_validation=when_supported (the configprovider default), not a captured request header. Native checksum values and errors are unchanged. Sources: https://github.com/boto/botocore/blob/1.43.98/botocore/handlers.py and https://github.com/boto/botocore/blob/1.43.98/botocore/configprovider.py.
